name: distinct-dimension-pressure
description: Measure integer distinct and grouped exact cardinality under different key domains

queries.name: by-region-distinct-user
queries.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

queries.name: by-category-distinct-user
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: by-region-category-distinct-user
queries.sql: SELECT region, category, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events GROUP BY region, category ORDER BY region, category
